tagline: Pizza the Hutt sends his regards.

Seconds if the cook likes you. Prices subject to change, paid in ship's credit. Printed by the ship's system. Form G-2345, sheet 2 of 2. 1987. Crew notes: Dark Helmet and Spaceball One. President Skroob's air shield code. Yoghurt and his merchandise.

Eagle 5 GalleySpaceballsSpace parody night. Snacks at full speed.Every recipe serves 4.

    StartersSpaceball One pretzelsChocolate pretzel rods striped plaid with candy meltsHow to make it200g dark chocolate20 pretzel rods100g coloured candy meltsMelt the dark chocolate.Dip each pretzel two-thirds of the way and set on baking paper.Melt the candy melts and pipe stripes across in two directions for plaid.Let set.Yoghurt's snack mixHoney butter mix of cereal, pretzels, peanuts and marshmallowsHow to make it150g cereal squares100g pretzels100g peanuts50g butter2 tbsp honey100g mini marshmallowsHeat the oven to 140°C. Melt the butter with the honey.Toss the cereal, pretzels and peanuts with the honey butter.Bake, stirring once.Cool completely, then toss through the marshmallows.MainsPizza the HuttMolten deep pan four-cheese pepperoni pizzaHow to make it600g pizza dough1 jar pizza sauce200g mozzarella100g provolone50g parmesan100g cheddar100g pepperoni1 tbsp vegetable oilOil a deep tray and press the dough in.Cover and prove until puffy.Spread with sauce and pile on the mozzarella, provolone, parmesan, cheddar and pepperoni.Bake at 220°C until molten and golden.Moon diner corned beef hash and eggsThe roadside diner on the moon, with an unexpected guestHow to make itAs written, serves 4Diced potatoes fried crisp with onion and shredded corned beef, two runny fried eggs on top, chives, hot sauce and buttered toast.Boil 800g diced potatoes for 6 minutes and drain well.Fry in 3 tbsp oil and 30g butter for 12 minutes until golden.Add 1 diced onion and cook 5 minutes, then fold in 400g shredded cooked corned beef and press flat for 5 minutes to crisp the bottom.Fry 8 eggs.Serve the hash topped with two eggs each, chives, hot sauce and buttered toast.SweetsYoghurt parfaitHoney vanilla yoghurt layered with granola and berriesHow to make it500g Greek yoghurt3 tbsp honey1 tsp vanilla extract200g granola250g mixed berriesWhip the yoghurt with the honey and vanilla.Layer in four tall glasses with the granola and berries.Finish with berries on top and serve straight away.DrinksPerri-Air sparkling lime and mint coolerFresh lime and mint muddled with sugar syrup and cucumber, topped with ice-cold sparkling water and served tall, as precious as a can of air.How to make it12 mint leaves4 slices of cucumber60ml sugar syrup4 limes600ml sparkling water1 bag ice4 mint sprigs, to garnishMuddle the mint, cucumber and sugar syrup in a jug.Add the juice of three limes and stir. Slice the last lime into wheels.Fill four tall glasses with ice, divide the mix between them and top with cold sparkling water.
